content.user_title: Analyze Therapeutic ML Datasets with PyTDC
content.value_statement: Drug discovery teams need consistent datasets and benchmarks. This skill guides PyTDC loading, splitting, evaluation, and oracle-based molecular generation.
actual_capabilities: Explains PyTDC dataset loading for ADME, toxicity, DTI, DDI, and generation tasks.
Shows scaffold, random, cold drug, cold target, and temporal split workflows.
Guides benchmark group evaluation with five seed protocols and standard metrics.
Documents molecular oracles for QED, SA, LogP, DRD2, GSK3B, and related targets.
Provides example scripts for loading data, evaluating benchmarks, and testing molecular generation.
Summarizes utility functions for molecule conversion, label transforms, and identifier retrieval.
limitations: It does not train models without user supplied model code and dependencies.
Some PyTDC datasets or oracles may require downloads, APIs, or optional packages.
Oracle scores are computational predictions, not experimental evidence.
Generated molecules still need chemistry review and laboratory validation.

use_cases.title: Prepare ADME Experiments
use_cases.description: Load ADME datasets, apply scaffold splits, and select metrics for reproducible property prediction.

use_cases.title: Run Benchmark Comparisons
use_cases.description: Evaluate models across TDC benchmark groups using the required five seed reporting protocol.

use_cases.title: Score Generated Molecules
use_cases.description: Use PyTDC oracles to score candidate molecules for target activity and drug-like properties.

prompt_templates.title: Load a Dataset
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pytdc skill to load an ADME dataset, describe its columns, and recommend a split method.

prompt_templates.title: Choose an Evaluation Metric
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pytdc skill to choose metrics for this TDC task and explain how to report validation results.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Benchmark Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pytdc skill to design a five seed benchmark evaluation workflow for my model and dataset.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Molecular Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the pytdc skill to plan oracle-based molecule scoring with QED, SA, LogP, and target activity constraints.

output_examples.input: I need a reproducible split for a Caco2 ADME experiment.
output: Recommended scaffold split with fixed seed and documented fractions.
Expected train, validation, and test roles for model development.
Suggested MAE reporting with mean and standard deviation when using benchmark groups.

output_examples.input: I generated candidate molecules and need PyTDC oracle guidance.
output: Suggested QED, SA, LogP, and target activity oracles.
A batch scoring workflow for candidate SMILES strings.
A reminder that oracle scores require chemistry review and experimental validation.

output_examples.input: I want to submit ADMET benchmark results.
output: A five seed evaluation plan using the official train, validation, and test splits.
A report outline with mean score, standard deviation, model name, and reproducibility notes.

best_practices: Use scaffold or cold splits when they match the scientific question.
Report seeds, split method, metric name, and dataset version with each result.
Validate oracle-ranked molecules with domain experts before acting on them.
anti_patterns: Do not compare models across different split methods without saying so.
Do not treat oracle scores as confirmed biological activity.
Do not submit leaderboard results from modified benchmark splits.

faq.question: What is PyTDC?
faq.answer: PyTDC is the Python interface for Therapeutics Data Commons datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and molecular oracles.

faq.question: Does this skill install PyTDC automatically?
faq.answer: No. It documents setup commands and workflows, but installation must be started by the user or their agent.

faq.question: Can it train a drug discovery model?
faq.answer: It provides dataset and evaluation guidance. The user must provide model architecture, training code, and compute resources.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are molecular oracle scores definitive?
faq.answer: No. Oracle scores are computational estimates and should be reviewed before experimental or clinical decisions.

faq.question: Does PyTDC need internet access?
faq.answer: Some datasets, documentation links, and optional oracle resources may require external access.
